svg.text: Reference boards, build step W1: palettes (proposals)
Green vale, Heather moor, Amber woods, Lake country, Rime coast. Every colour is a proposal for the designer to review; text and sources in reference-boards-w1.md.
Bar: rough share of the screen (the camera shows ground and the tops of things). S = HSV saturation. Discs: the red, yellow, blue, green and uncoloured warnings as the game blends them today.
